English.Char_Desc_80: Trim, split, join and fade videos and sound, then save as MP4, MP3 and more.
English.Char_Desc_250: Cut and join videos and sound files with big worded buttons: trim, split, delete or keep a marked part, insert clips, copy and paste, change the order, set volume and fades, add music or narration, then save a new file.
English.Char_Desc_450: Cut and join videos and sound files with big worded buttons: trim, split, delete or keep a marked part, insert clips, copy and paste, change the order, set volume and fades, add music or narration, then save a new file. Free. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit; nothing else to install.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Video Editor opens videos and sound files and lets you trim them, split a piece at the playhead, delete or keep a marked part, insert other clips, copy and paste parts, and change the order. Each piece has its own mute, volume (up to 200%), fade in and fade out, and Add music or narration lays a sound over the edit, mixed in or replacing the original sound. Undo and Redo cover every edit, and the preview plays the edit with its cuts and sound. Save as MP4, MOV, M4V, MKV, WebM, AVI, WMV or MPG video, or MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, Opus or WMA sound. The files you open are never changed. Everything it needs, including ffmpeg for saving, is included.
Before you install: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Video Editor is free to use and share. Download sites may list it and offer the unchanged Setup.exe, or link to the download page.
Permissions.EULA: Video Editor is free and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk. The free parts it is built from keep their own licenses, listed in the licenses folder it installs.
